description: Full spine traversal from idea-pmf through finance. Asserts all 13 stages activated in order, all HARD discipline sets present, no over-run past finance.

turns.text: Activate cycle:full. I want to take this raw problem all the way to a measured, financed product. Start at idea-pmf and traverse through finance.
Continue: strategy-positioning — sharpen the positioning and validate the problem framing.
Continue: analysis-discovery — technical discovery and current-state comparison.
Continue: specification — write the spec with acceptance criteria.
Continue: design-ux — UX flows and component designs.
Continue: architecture — API design, system ADR, data model.
Continue: ai-ml — AI route design and eval corpus.
Continue: quality-release — run tests, pass reliability gate.
Continue: growth — channel fit and acquisition plan.
Continue: sales-cs — CS playbook and activation plan.
Continue: finance — unit economics verdict. This is the final stage. Stop after finance; do not chain further.
